title: adx_setting
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, ownerid, owningbusinessunit, owningteam, owninguser.

adx_name.description: The name of the custom entity.

createdon.description: Shows when the record was created.

importsequencenumber.description: Sequence number of the import that created this record.

modifiedon.description: Shows when the record was modified.

overriddencreatedon.description: Shows when the record was migrated.

utcconversiontimezonecode.description: Shows the time zone code that was in use when the record was created.

_createdby_value.description: Shows the user who created the record.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Shows the delegate user who created the record.

_modifiedby_value.description: Shows the user who modified the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Shows the delegate user who modified the record.

_owningbusinessunit_value.description: Shows the business unit that owns the record.

_owningteam_value.description: Unique identifier for the team that owns the record.

_owninguser_value.description: Unique identifier for the user that owns the record.
